Name: Easter Bunnies
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[b]🐰 Easter Bunnies Mod 🐰[/b]
This mod adds Easter Bunnies to Stardew Valley.
You can buy them from Marnie at Marnie’s Ranch 🏡
When you buy a bunny, it comes in 1 of 7 random colors
pink 💗 purple 💜 green 💚 turquoise 🩵 orange 🧡 blue 💙 yellow 💛
The bunnies walk around and find Easter eggs for your farm 🥚🐇

[color=#ff0000]NEW 1.0.1 UPDATE! CHOCOLATE CREMES ARE FUNCTIONAL:[/color]
Chocolate cremes now come in different flavors like strawberry, orange, mint, italian charamel, pistachio,caramel and lavender.
You can apply them on any food you want to increase the sell price and add a nice chocolate creme flavor. Here's how:

1. Press "esc" to open the inventory menu and pick up your creme chocolate, then put it on the food you like
[img width=428,height=223]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1334937035856810025/1503057913894277181/2026-05-10_5.png?ex=6a01f744&is=6a00a5c4&hm=81eb00b41fb81f0c71bfb13ca0f07ac6d1d5e11864612d85595a95ca2c4aa39b&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=535&height=279[/img]

2. Done! You have your food with a chocolate creme topping
[img width=926,height=193]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1334937035856810025/1503058241465352232/2026-05-10_6.png?ex=6a01f792&is=6a00a612&hm=324774b85b166aacb357b22c940c377018028558ffb9f52151a30b3bbeea9805&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1158&height=241[/img]


[b]What you can do with the eggs[/b]
You can eat them
You can put them in the Preserves Jar to make colorful chocolate cremes 🍫
Both the eggs and the chocolate cremes can be sold

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI
Content Patcher

[b]How to install[/b]
Download the mod
Unzip it
Put the mod folder into your Mods folder
Example path
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

[b]Important[/b]
Do not merge file contents
Keep each mod in its own folder inside Mods ✅

WARNING:
This mod clashes with the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]" Mod when it comes to purchasing the bunnies from Marnie's shop.
However if you want to use both of these mods together, you ca get the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod which allows you to control your mods without deleting them. When purchasing the bunnies, you can simply turn off the livestock bazaar shop menu from GMCM, and after you're done you can turn it back on without any problems!

Downloads.Description: This zip contains 2 files. Both are necessary for the mod to work. Do not merge the files together in the mods folder.
